newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London slip, cautious after HK rally.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London slip, cautious after HK rally.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London nudged lower on Monday as an overnight rally in Hong Kong failed to carry through to London and weakness in UK shares weighed on stocks, traders said.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 34.22 points, or 0.27 percent, at 12,714.92 by 1530 GMT.
"I don't think people trust the movement in Hong Kong overnight and no-one's jumping in to follow it," one trader said.
Traders said bank stocks were weaker this morning, and despite rebounding later in the day they were still trading below Hong Kong closing levels.
They said all the property developers were marked lower after good rises overnight.
HSBC Holdings was trading at HK$178.125 in London after closing at HK$178.500 in Hong Kong, and Wharf Holdings was at HK$30.850 after closing in Hong Kong at HK$31.200.
